title: Splatoon Music Disc Pack
description: Nintendo Music Disc Series: VOLUME II
body:
This Data and Resource Pack collection adds 21 craftable music discs from Splatoon.

### TRACKLIST
All track names are sourced from the Nintendo Music app. Songs have been sources from the [Splatune](https://splatoonwiki.org/wiki/Splatune_(Splatoon_Original_Soundtrack)) and [Splatoon Live in Makuhari](https://splatoonwiki.org/wiki/Splatoon_Live_in_Makuhari_-Shiokalive-) soundtrack releases.
- Opening (Squid Squad)
- Splattack! (Squid Squad)
- Ink or Sink (Squid Squad)
- Seaskape (Squid Squad)
- Kraken Up (Squid Squad)
- Metalopod (Squid Squad)
- Shellfie (Chirpy Chips)
- Split $ Splat (Chirpy Chips)
- Hooked (Hightide Era)
- Sucker Punch (Hightide Era)
- Now or Never! (Squid Squad)
- City of Color (Squid Sister)
- Ink Me Up (Squid Sister)
- Now or Never! (Squid Sister)
- Eight-Legged Advance (Turquoise October)
- Tentacular Circus (Turquoise October)
- Octoling Rendezvous (Turquoise October)
- Octoweaponry (Turquoise October)
- I Am Octavio (DJ Octavio)
- Calamari Inkantation (Squid Sister)
- Maritime Memory (Squid Sister)

### CRAFTING GUIDE
A smithing table is required to obtain discs added in these packs. The recipes are displayed in the Advancements tab, which unlocks when you obtain any Music Disc and either a Orange or Blue Dye. The Advancement tab shows a checklist of each song with the required *"addition"* item needed to obtain it as the Advancement icon.
